messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — updated PR #4218. Addressed reviewers' comments: renamed param to `route_hint`, added a smoke test for the api-shim, and reduced the default batch size. CI on linux is green but macOS had a flaky integration failure: https://ci.example.com/build/5678. Hoping to merge before Friday's canary window. @Alex @Rohit PTAL.

Alex Varga: On it. Quick note: in the route helper the param rename to `route_hint` sounds right. Can you also drop a one-line changelog entry?

Maya Chen: Done both. Pushed commit `9a8b7f`. Also stubbed the clock in the flaky test to remove timing dependence. Reran locally and tests pass.

Rohit Singh: Does this change any behavior for Dedicated customers or require a migration step? We should flag it if so.

Maya Chen: No behavior change for Dedicated — opt-in only. I added a small migration note to docs/ops/README.md and linked it in the PR description.

CI-Bot: linux/amd64  build passed. macOS/arm  integration::session-timeout failed (timeout). Rerun queued (job 1765010600).

Sara Lopez: If the mac test can't be stabilized today, can we still merge and monitor the canary? We have a tight window but prefer to avoid flaky tests slipping in.

Alex Varga: Prefer to stabilize if the canary window allows. If we must merge, prepare a rollback playbook and add alerting to catch regressions during canary.

Maya Chen: Reworked the test to use a clock stub and removed timing reliance. Pushed commit `bb2c11`. PTAL when you have ~5 mins 🙂. Added a short perf note about batching defaults to the PR.

Alex Varga: Scanned the diffs — LGTM after the test change. Left one tiny wording nit in the docs. :+1: 

Rohit Singh: Approved. Merge when CI is green and canary is scheduled.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — CI is green now. Scheduling canary for Friday 09:00 UTC. Will merge in 10 minutes unless anyone objects.

Alex Varga: No objections. :rocket:

CI-Bot: macOS/arm  build passed.
